name: Called-target serve under pressure
summary: Partner calls a target (deep middle, deep sideline, short angle) after the server sets; a fault resets the score.
setup: Cones mark 3 targets in each diagonal service box: deep middle, deep sideline, short angle
The partner calls the target only once the server is set, as in a match
Score +1 for the called target, 0 for in but missed target, and a fault resets the score to 0
success_criterion: In a set of 20 serves: at least 18 in, at least 12 on the called target
coach_rationale: (judgment) Late target calls and a reset on a fault add match-like pressure to serve placement, so serve faults (AN-05) and serve effectiveness (AN-01) hold when it matters. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
